race.human.description: +1 to all ability scores. Humans are adaptable and ambitious, thriving in every environment.
race.elf.description: +2 Dexterity. Elves have darkvision (60ft), Fey Ancestry (advantage on saves vs. charm), and trance (4hr rest).
race.dwarf.description: +2 Constitution. Dwarves have darkvision (60ft), resistance to magic, and trained for combat with axes.
race.halfling.description: +2 Dexterity, +1 Luck. Halflings are Small, brave, nimble, and lucky — reroll 1s on attack rolls, saves, and checks.
race.dragonborn.description: +2 Strength, +2 Charisma. Dragonborn breathe fire (15ft line, DEX save), have resistance to fire damage, and intimidate easily.
race.half-elf.description: +2 Charisma, +1 two other abilities. Half-elves gain darkvision (60ft), Fey Ancestry, and two extra skill proficiencies.
race.gnome.description: +2 Intelligence. Gnomes have darkvision (60ft), advantage on INT/WIS/CHA saves vs. magic, and can talk to beasts/magic animals.
race.half-orc.description: +2 Strength, +2 Constitution. Half-orcs have darkvision (60ft), Menacing (Intimidation proficiency), Relentless Endurance (drop to 1 HP instead of 0 once per long rest), and Savage Attacks (extra die on crits).
class.fighter.description: +2 STR or DEX. Extra Attack (multiple attacks per action), Second Wind (regain 1d10+fighter level HP as bonus action).
class.wizard.description: +2 INT. Spellcasting with the largest spell list, Arcane Recovery (recover spell slots once per day after short rest).
class.rogue.description: +2 DEX, +1 INT. Sneak Attack (+1d6 damage when advantage or ally nearby), Expertise (double proficiency in 2 skills), Thieves' Cant.
class.cleric.description: +2 WIS, +1 CHA. Spellcasting (healing & divine magic), Channel Divinity, Divine Domain features based on chosen domain.
class.barbarian.description: +2 STR, +2 CON. Rage (bonus damage + resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing as bonus action), Reckless Attack (advantage on melee attacks).
class.paladin.description: +2 STR, +1 CHA. Spellcasting (smite & protection magic), Divine Sense, Lay on Hands (healing pool = 5 × paladin level).
class.ranger.description: +2 DEX, +1 WIS. Favored Enemy (+5 to wisdom checks against creature type), Natural Explorer (advantage on survival in chosen terrain).
class.sorcerer.description: +2 CHA, +1 CON. Spellcasting from innate magical bloodline, Metamagic (modify spells at cost of sorcery points).
class.artificer.description: +2 INT, +1 CON. Spellcasting infused with technology, Infusions (enhance objects), Tool Proficiency bonus.
class.monk.description: +2 DEX, +2 WIS. Martial Arts (unarmed strikes + ki damage), Unarmored Defense (AC = 10+DEX+WIS), Ki abilities like Flurry of Blows.
class.bard.description: +2 CHA, +1 two others. Spellcasting (inspiration & magic), Bardic Inspiration (d6 dice to help allies), Jack of All Trades (+½ proficiency everywhere).
class.warlock.description: +2 CHA, +1 WIS. Pact Magic (fewer but powerful spell slots recovered on short rest), Eldritch Blast cantrip, Pact Boon (weapon/book/chair).
